[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Ascalon Foothills | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=103 }} The [[Ascalon Foothills]] slopes up to the west to meet the cold sides of [[the Shiverpeaks]]. It is a small area populated by [[elemental]]s and [[hydra]], one of the most dangerous foes in the [[Ascalon]] [[region]] to the ill-prepared. ==Getting there== Leave from [[Yak's Bend]] southeast through [[Traveler's Vale]] or from [[Nolani Academy (outpost)|Nolani Academy]] or [[Grendich Courthouse]] and travel north/west (respectively) through [[Diessa Lowlands]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s *Northwest, at the exit into [[Traveler's Vale]]. *Southeast, at the exit into [[Diessa Lowlands]]. ;[[Statue of Grenth]] *North, along the edge where the terrain turns to snow. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Dael]] ([[collector]] for 3 [[Leathery Claw]]s) *{{x}} 2 (20) [[Artisan Rudger]] ([[artisan]]) ===Foes=== [[Elemental]]s *{{w}} 7 (23) [[Boulder Elemental]] *{{e}} 8 (23) [[Stone Fury]] [[Hydra]]s *{{e}} 10 (24) [[Hydra (Ascalon)|Hydra]] [[Plant]]s *{{r}} 10 (24) [[Singed Oak]] ==Notes== *[[Interactive object]]s **[[Oswalt's Headstone]] *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 55|low = 51|high = 59}} **If starting from [[Yak's Bend]] or [[Borlis Pass]], you can come to this area with a [[party]] size of 6. Consider continuing onwards into [[Diessa Lowlands]] with the larger group. == Trivia== *According to a list on Guild Wars Guru, which seems to list various beta locations, this zone was previously called ''Hillclimb''.[https://web.archive.org/web/20050301030823/http://www.guildwarsguru.com/ascalon-id13.php List of Ascalon locations], Guild Wars Guru (archived) There was also another map called Ascalon Foothills, but it connected to [[Regent Valley]], [[Pockmark Flats]], and [[Eastern Frontier]] (called The Shift), which doesn't have a correlating location in the final version.[https://web.archive.org/web/20050406054226/http://www.guildwarsguru.com/content/ascalon-foothills-id76.php Ascalon Foothills], Guild Wars Guru (archived) == References == {{Explorable areas in Ascalon}} [[de:Ascalon-Vorgebirge]]
